# principle-naming

Use when naming or renaming anything another reader will meet later: a file, a directory, a report or document, a scratch artifact, a variable, function, type, constant, branch, or commit subject. Fires before writing any new file, whenever a name is about to carry a generic stem, a number, a date, a version word, an acronym, or a codename, and when reviewing names in a diff. Exists to stop one failure: names that only decode for someone who was in the session.

Ships in the [`pstack`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install pstack@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add pstack@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install pstack@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
